input.domain: Explicitly present decoded validUTF8 Text0..1024bytes inclusive. Empty and invalid-header-name strings remain supported diagnostic inputs. Missing/wrong types/malformed rawUTF8/lone surrogate escapes/decoded1025bytes are outside the supported pure call.
input.wire_limit: The bundled inputs are trusted fixtures. This example adds no external JSON preprocessor and does not establish malformed-input refusal by the generic nativeCLI.

semantics.key: Exact decoded input Text, no normalization.
semantics.canonical_key: Only actual imported Gooo CanonicalMIMEHeaderKey output. Invalid-token or empty input returns whole original key.
semantics.changed: canonical_key != key, computed by original Gooo consumer.
semantics.name_valid: Existing HeaderFacts.Report(key,empty_value).name_valid; empty isfalse. This diagnostic is separate from canonicalization success.
semantics.input_bytes: Original decoded UTF8 byte length, exact signed64.
semantics.canonical_bytes: Canonical output UTF8 byte length, equal to input length in this bounded contract.
semantics.name_invalid_offset: Existing HeaderFacts first invalid raw UTF8 byte offset, or-1; empty has no bad byte so-1 despite name_validfalse.
semantics.name_invalid_octet: Existing HeaderFacts first invalid byte0..255, or-1 for valid/empty.

manual_scalar_truth_guard.scope: Twenty manually authored canonical Text anchors, unchanged; not generated Go expected outputs or1059 extra tests.

scope: Original Gooo computes canonical Text and the full8field report; Go supplies only independent references/evidence.
No per-request human approval, external effect or model call is needed for these pure calculations.
Normalization is ASCII header-name casing only for valid tokens. Invalid header names return the whole input unchanged; unchanged never implies valid.
No HTTP parser,header repair,sending,HTTP2 name rules,authority,request binding or production safety.
Fresh current public source native execution/saved replay/fullCI remain required. Private original receipts are not rebound as public acceptance.
The generic finite receipt checker does not independently establish the entire inner canonical generation/typed-parent protocol.
